failed.effectOnThisRead: none. No family in this cohort is an Alabama family, every source this read measured resolved by content hash from mounted custody, and a source that had not would have been recorded NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE rather than counted as a zero.

preflight.notedContainerFix: private/ is reached through symlinks here, and `git check-ignore private/` refuses a pathspec beyond a symbolic link, so private/ was remade as a real directory holding a symlink per custody. .gitignore already ignores private/ and nothing beneath it is tracked; no repository file was changed.

method.claimBeforeRead: node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert VF08 <familyId>, per family, before any artifact of that family was opened. A non-zero exit would have been a full stop for that family.
method.sourceResolution: every bound document resolved by the SHA-256 its receipt pins, against every mounted custody indexed by content. A digest no custody holds is NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE for that document and no verdict rests on it.
method.zeroWriteBaseline: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs sanitizeAndFlatten over the pinned bytes, writtenFields empty, suppressSynthesizedAppearances false — the construction scripts/rcap-official-forms/test-synthesized-off-appearances.mjs uses for case A, and the one VF02 and VF03 used on Vermont and Virginia.
method.isolatingControl: the same zero-write flatten with suppressSynthesizedAppearances true. The pixels the option-off run paints and the option-on run does not ARE the synthesized square, at that widget's own geometry. Measuring against that footprint rather than against a pixel threshold is what lets a form that prints its own box under the widget be read correctly instead of hiding the square in its own ink.
method.negativeControl: recorded per document as pixelsTheOptionChangesOverTheWholeDocument. Where turning the option on changes no rendered pixel anywhere on a document, that document's flatten paints no square at all, and a clean read on it is a real zero rather than a dead measurement. That case occurred once, on Connecticut's JD-CR-202.
method.rasterisation: pdftoppm, 150 dpi, greyscale, into /tmp; a pixel is ink below 200. Every raster deleted after measuring.
method.alignment: delivered pages matched to source pages by ink overlap and never by a declared page manifest, then each widget rect licensed separately by a local ink-coverage check at that rect. A page no fixture reproduces is recorded as reaching no delivered page; a page partly reproduced and not closely enough to read is NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE.
whatIsNotCounted: a widget the family writes: its mark is intended and is not this defect
a widget that ships its own appearance for its current state: RI-OFF-APPEARANCE settles that the court's own stream stays, and the opt-in option does not touch it
a widget whose synthesized square falls entirely on ink the form already prints, so no ink reaches the page: counted and reported separately, never as the defect
